# Set up
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")

# Define pathogen
pat_l <- c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "polio", "hib",
              "ipv", "opv", "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv",
              "multi_ipv", "multi_pertu", "multi_men", "multi_polio", "multi_opv",
              "multi_dtp", "multi_dtpa", "multi_dtpw", "multi_hib-men", "multi_mmr", "multi_mmr-vzv")

pat_l <- c("rota")
```

# Loop it s08 sub kgc 
```{r}
mcom_l <- sapply(str_subset(list.files("../outputs/modres_mcom", full.names = TRUE), ".rds"), readRDS, simplify = FALSE)
names(mcom_l) <- str_remove_all(names(mcom_l), "../outputs/modres_mcom/mcom_|.rds")

# mcom_l$measles_cs_base[[2]] <- mcom_l$measles_cs_base[[1]]
# mcom_l$measles_cs_base[[10]] <- mcom_l$measles_cs_base[[1]]
# mcom_l$pertu_cs_base[[5]] <- mcom_l$pertu_cs_base[[1]]
# mcom_l$pertu_cs_base[[7]] <- mcom_l$pertu_cs_base[[1]]
# mcom_l$pertu_cs_base[[8]] <- mcom_l$pertu_cs_base[[1]]
# mcom_l$pn_cs_base[[2]] <- mcom_l$pn_cs_base[[1]] 
# mcom_l$pn_cs_base[[6]] <- mcom_l$pn_cs_base[[1]] 
# mcom_l$rubella_cs_base[[5]] <- mcom_l$rubella_cs_base[[1]]
# mcom_l$rubella_cs_base[[7]] <- mcom_l$rubella_cs_base[[1]]


bind_cols(sapply(str_subset(names(mcom_l), "cs_base"), function(x) {
  unlist(lapply(mcom_l[[x]], function(x) x$bf))
}, simplify = FALSE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(mean_value = mean(value)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = reorder(name, mean_value))) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log")

bind_cols(sapply(str_subset(names(mcom_l), "csni_base"), function(x) {
  lapply(mcom_l[[x]], function(x) {
    unlist(lapply(x, function(x) x$bf))
      }) %>%
    bind_cols()
}, simplify = FALSE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("bm","s0", "pathogen", "mod", "r", "reg")) %>%
  select(pathogen, reg, value) %>%
  mutate(reg = as.character(glue("reg_{reg}"))) %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(mean_value = mean(value)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = reorder(pathogen, mean_value), color = reg)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log")

mcom_l$multi_mmrv_csi_base$bmv1_s08_multi_mmrv_csi_reg_6a_gauss.rds[[4]] <- mcom_l$multi_mmrv_csi_base$bmv1_s08_multi_mmrv_csi_reg_6a_gauss.rds[[1]]

test <- sapply(str_subset(names(mcom_l), "csi_base"), function(x) {
  lapply(mcom_l[[x]], function(x) {
    unlist(lapply(x, function(x) {x$bf
      no = x$bf
      if(is.null(no)) no = NA
      return(no)
      }))
      }) %>%
    bind_cols()
}, simplify = FALSE) 


bind_cols(test) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "multi_", "multi")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("bm","s0", "pathogen", "mod", "r", "reg")) %>%
  select(pathogen, reg, value) %>%
  filter(!(pathogen %in% c("hav", "multihibmen", "ipv","opv","polio", "pertu", "dipht", "tetan",
                           "multipertu", "multimmrv"))) %>%
  mutate(reg = as.character(glue("reg_{reg}"))) %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(mean_value = mean(value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(updown = value >= 10^0.5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  #filter(value > 10^-20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = reorder(pathogen, mean_value), color = updown)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous("Bayes factor (photoperiod model over base model)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.25, end = 0.75) + 
  facet_grid(~reg) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}
}
```

# Checking convergence
```{r}
df_rhats_cs <- readRDS("outputs/_mcom/df_rhats_cs.rds")
df_rhats_cs2i <- readRDS("outputs/_mcom/df_rhats_cs2i.rds")

df_rhats_cs %>%
  filter(Rhat == TRUE)

df_rhats_cs2i %>%
  filter(Rhat == FALSE) %>%
  filter(str_detect(pathogen, "multi"))
```

Not converging: 

- multi-DTP, photoperiod 6a model. 
- multi-ipv, photoperiod 3 model. 
- multi-mmrv, photoperiod 4 and 6a models. 
- multi-pertu, photoperiod 6a model. 
- multi-polio, photoperiod 6a model. 

- HAV, none of the photoperiod models. 
- multi-hibmen, all of the photoperiod models. 
- multi-men, all of the photoperiod models. 
- multi-opv, photoperiod 3, 4 and 6a models and 2b did not run. 
- multi-pn, all models. 

Converging cs2i: 
hbv, kgc_1_reg_2b -                     kgc1.rds	
hib, kgc_2_reg_2b and kgc_1_reg_2b -    kgc2.rds	
men, kgc_1_reg_2b -	                    kgc1.rds
pertu, kgc_2_reg_2b -	                  kgc2.rds
pn, kgc_1_reg_2b -                      kgc1.rds
polio, kgc_3_reg_3, and kgc_3_reg_4 -   kgc3.rds	
rota, all -                             kgc3.rds

multi_dtp, kgc_1_reg_2b, kgc_1_reg_3, kgc_1_reg_4 -     kgc1.rds
multi_men, kgc_1_reg_2b -                               kgc1.rds
multi_pertu, kgc_1_reg_2b, kgc_2_reg_2b                 kgc2.rds	


```{r}
mcom_l <- sapply(str_subset(list.files("outputs/_mcom/photoclim", full.names = TRUE), ".rds"), readRDS, simplify = FALSE)
names(mcom_l) <- str_remove_all(names(mcom_l), "outputs/_mcom/photoclim/mcom_|.rds")

test_csi <- sapply(str_subset(names(mcom_l), "csi_base"), function(x) {
  lapply(mcom_l[[x]], function(x) {
    unlist(lapply(x, function(x) {x$bf
      no = x$bf
      if(is.null(no)) no = NA
      return(no)
      }))
      }) %>%
    bind_cols()
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_cols() %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "multi_", "multi"),
         name = str_replace(name, "kgc_", "kgc"),
         name = str_replace(name, "reg_", "reg")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("bm","s0", "pathogen", "mod", "reg", "df"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(mod, pathogen, reg, df, value) %>%
  mutate(kgc = "csi")


test_cs2i <- sapply(str_subset(names(mcom_l), "cs2i_csi"), function(x) {
  lapply(mcom_l[[x]], function(x) {
    unlist(lapply(x, function(x) {x$bf
      no = x$bf
      if(is.null(no)) no = NA
      return(no)
      }))
      }) %>%
    bind_cols()
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_cols() %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "multi_", "multi"),
         name = str_replace(name, "kgc_", "kgc"),
         name = str_replace(name, "reg_", "reg")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("bm","s0", "pathogen", "mod", "kgc", "reg", "df"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(mod, pathogen, kgc, reg, df, value) 

bind_rows(test_cs2i, test_csi) %>%
  mutate(updown = value >= 10^0.5) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = mod, color = updown, shape = kgc)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous("Bayes factor (photoperiod model over base model)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(begin = 0.25, end = 0.75) + 
  facet_grid(pathogen~reg, scales = "free") + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

# pn, kgc_1_reg_2b -                      kgc1.rds
```
